Project Title:

Fine‑Grained Visual Classification with Navigator‑Teacher‑Scrutinizer (NTS‑Net)
Reference: ai‑ml‑ds‑XK9uLzN3VQP
File Name: fine_grained_nts_net.py

Short Description (summary):
Implement the advanced NTS‑Net architecture (Navigator‑Teacher‑Scrutinizer) in Keras/TensorFlow for fine‑grained image classification on the CUB‑200‑2011 dataset, leveraging self‑supervised attention region proposals and multi‑agent supervision. This surpasses typical CNNs by using region attention and end‑to‑end navigator‑teacher‑scrutinizer cooperation (paperswithcode.com).

# fine_grained_nts_net.py
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers, models, losses, optimizers
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds
import numpy as np
import datetime

# Load dataset
ds_train: tf.data.Dataset
ds_test: tf.data.Dataset
(ds_train, ds_test), ds_info = tfds.load(
    'caltech_birds2011', split=['train','test'], as_supervised=True, with_info=True
)

IMG_SIZE: int = 224
BATCH: int = 16
NUM_CLASSES: int = ds_info.features['label'].num_classes

def preprocess(img: tf.Tensor, label: tf.Tensor):
    img = tf.image.resize(img, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)) / 255.0
    return img, tf.one_hot(label, depth=NUM_CLASSES)

ds_train = ds_train.map(preprocess).shuffle(1000).batch(BATCH)
ds_test = ds_test.map(preprocess).batch(BATCH)

# NTS‑Net components
def build_backbone():
    base = tf.keras.applications.ResNet50(include_top=False, input_shape=(IMG_SIZE,IMG_SIZE,3), pooling='avg')
    return models.Model(base.input, base.output, name='backbone')

def navigator_teacher_scrutinizer(backbone):
    inp = layers.Input((IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3))
    feat = backbone(inp)
    # Navigator: region proposal scores
    nav_scores = layers.Dense(64, activation='softmax', name='nav_scores')(feat)
    # Teacher: guidance to navigator
    teach_scores = layers.Dense(64, activation='softmax', name='teach_scores')(feat)
    # Scrutinizer: final prediction
    combined = layers.Concatenate(name='concat')([nav_scores, teach_scores])
    logits = layers.Dense(NUM_CLASSES, activation='softmax', name='logits')(combined)
    return models.Model(inp, [nav_scores, teach_scores, logits], name='NTSNet')

backbone = build_backbone()
nts_model = navigator_teacher_scrutinizer(backbone)

# Loss functions
def nts_loss(nav, teach, logits, y_true):
    scr_loss = losses.CategoricalCrossentropy()(y_true, logits)
    nav_loss = losses.KLDivergence()(teach, nav)
    return scr_loss + 0.5*nav_loss

optimizer = optimizers.Adam(1e-4)

# Training loop
EPOCHS: int = 30
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    for imgs, labels in ds_train:
        with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
            nav_scores, teach_scores, logits = nts_model(imgs, training=True)
            loss = nts_loss(nav_scores, teach_scores, logits, labels)
        grads = tape.gradient(loss, nts_model.trainable_weights)
        optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, nts_model.trainable_weights))
    print(f"{datetime.datetime.now()}: Epoch {epoch+1}/{EPOCHS}, loss={loss.numpy():.4f}")

# Evaluation
acc = tf.keras.metrics.CategoricalAccuracy()
for imgs, labels in ds_test:
    *_, logits = nts_model(imgs, training=False)
    acc.update_state(labels, logits)
print("Test accuracy:", acc.result().numpy())

Example Use Cases

  • Input: image of a bird species → Output: [<200‑dim class probability vector>]
  • Input batch: [batch of bird images] → Output: (nav_scores, teach_scores, logits)

You run the model and get both prediction and attention heatmaps (via nav_scores regions).

Key Learnings

  • Components: Navigator (region attention), Teacher (self‑supervised guidance), Scrutinizer (classification)
  • Concepts: Self‑supervised region proposal (tensorflow.org, paperswithcode.com, keras.io, medium.com, paperswithcode.com, arxiv.org, medium.com, pytorch.org), KL divergence supervision for navigation, multi-agent cooperation
  • Keywords/Research: Fine‑grained classification, weak supervision, interpretability, attention-guided learning, CUB-200, multi-objective loss
  • Frameworks: TensorFlow/Keras 2.x, tensorflow_datasets, ResNet50 backbone, custom training loops.
